name: Nuzzuo
epithet: Acting leader of the Har Hali
personality: Proud, tradition-bound warrior who speaks with forest spirits.
story: Nuzzuo leads the Har Hali tribe after their chieftain vanished, and he reveres the demon god Balor. He first clashes with Cai and company when they trespass on the tribe's sacred grounds. He appears in Dagsion from around 1/7; on Cai's route he costs 3x Iron Bow at Renown 6, Support 2.

personalSkill.name: Har Hali Wisdom
personalSkill.effect: If unit is effective against foe, Atk+3 during combat. Lv20: Precision Strike (Hit+10 vs effective foes); Lv35: Precision Strike+ (Hit+20).

tierNotes: Pocket Tactics: A tier. KeenGamer: C tier (fragile). fortunesweave.co.uk rates Har Hali Wisdom 2/5. Reddit: Ranger or Forest Knight with a Horsekiller bow is excellent against cavalry and fliers in Parts II and III (confirmed).

why: Renown 6 here is the earliest join.
Diego is his only support partner in this army.
recruit.tip: Ready from Ch 9 (in Dagsion ~7/1). Recruit him Ch 9 week 1 at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class. The Levin Sword he'd bring at Lv 20+ (Ch 10+) comes from Jester instead.

guide.role: Part II bench: second bow and effective-weapon skirmisher
guide.summary: Part II's second bow and effective-weapon hunter: Ch 4 Dragoons and elephants with Lilian, Ch 6 Lyrah shield chip. Swap to the weapon each target is weak to (bow vs fliers, Zanbato vs cavalry, Flyssa vs armor): Har Hali Wisdom adds Atk +3 and [[ability:Precision Strike+]] Hit +20 there.
guide.playstyle: Sword skirmisher first (Spd 55 growth), bow when fliers show. Pick effective matchups only: Def 20 and Res 15 growth mean he can't trade hits.
keys: Recruit Ch 9 week 1 (~7/1): Renown 6, 3 Iron Bows. Lv 15, no Levin Sword.
Seat him in every Ch 9 to 12 dungeon party: bow chip, sword kills, Grounder on fliers.
Take [[class:Rogue]] at Lv 20 with Bow C and Sword C (Ch 9 end or Ch 10 week 1).
Spend Arena Infantry seats on Bow B and Sword B: the bench gets seats first.
Ch 10: Da Mina Sword and Bow +1, +2 at Renown 10 (Ch 12); pack them with Zanbato, Flyssa, Concoction.
Part II Ch 2: kill the west Ranger (moves Turn 8) for the Horsekiller Bow +1.
watch: Def 20, Res 15 growth: he dies to anything he can't kill first.
Weight: Da Mina Sword +2 4 or Da Mina Bow 6, no accessory: Def 20 growth, he can't afford a double. Horsekiller Bow +2 (8) only on fliers or cavalry.
Levels: Lv 15 on 7/1, about Lv 28 to 30? by Ch 12; Army Training only tops him up to Lv 34.
Inventory: 5/6 into Part II; slot 6 takes the Ch 2 Horsekiller Bow +1.
